name: Additive intracranial hypertension risk
actions: Review for additional agents or conditions associated with intracranial hypertension.
Monitor for persistent headache, visual changes, pulsatile tinnitus, or other concerning neurologic symptoms.
Escalate for clinical evaluation when symptoms suggest possible intracranial hypertension.

rationale: Both drugs are associated with intracranial hypertension risk.
Overlapping risk factors may warrant additional clinical awareness.
